people.name: Darius
people.line: Mede who became Emperor over Babylon

translations.web: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom one hundred twenty local governors, who should be throughout the whole kingdom;
translations.bsb: Now it pleased Darius to appoint 120 satraps to rule throughout the kingdom,
translations.kjv: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom an hundred and twenty princes, which should be over the whole kingdom;
